subject: Private rollout governance & network ownership for upcoming patch window
messages:
From: Taylor Reed <taylor.reed@acmehealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>; Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: AcmeHealth Platform Ops <ops@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Private cluster - proposed maintenance window and version pin question

Hi Markus / Karthik,

We're preparing for our quarterly maintenance for the private deployment (VPC) and need to coordinate a Redwood-side patch for the inference runtime. Two quick asks:

1) Can Redwood support a hard pin to runtime v3.2.1 for our fleet during the window to avoid unintended minor bumps?
2) We need an ops-level owner from Redwood to be on the bridge and confirm rollback criteria.

Proposed windows (our local times):
- Fri 2026-12-03 02:00-04:00 UTC (low traffic)
- Mon 2026-12-06 22:00-00:00 UTC (backup)

I've attached our current runbook for the private cluster (acme_runbook_v2.pdf). We also need to confirm network ownership for any BGP quiesce activity during drains.

Thanks,
Taylor
Taylor Reed
Platform Lead, AcmeHealth
[tel] +1 415-555-0134

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Reed <taylor.reed@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:01:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private cluster - proposed maintenance window and version pin question

Thanks Taylor — this is clear and the runbook is helpful. Looping in Karthik (runtime), Neha (security/compliance), and Monica (customer ops) to confirm the plan. Quick answers up-front:

- We can pin to v3.2.1 for the maintenance window. We recommend an explicit pin+hold policy so automated canary/auto-updates are disabled for the tenant during the window.
- Redwood will provide an ops owner on the bridge. Suggested primary: Markus Klein (me) and fallback: Karthik Iyer.
- Network quiesce (BGP/cutover) must be coordinated with your netops. Redwood can execute service drain + node cordon; we will not touch BGP prefixes without your explicit sign-off.

Open items for action:
- Karthik: confirm rollback artifact sizes and KV-cache rehydrate time (this affects RTO).
- Neha: confirm audit/logging retention change for the window and whether you require immutable snapshots before patch.
- Monica: confirm preferred primary window and any blackout periods for your backups.

Proposed governance: a short decision tree on the bridge:
1) If preflight health checks fail (p95 latency > 1200ms OR error rate > 1%) -> abort and shelve pins.
2) If mid-window regressions persist > 10 minutes -> rollback to v3.1.9 and run targeted smoke tests.
3) If rollback fails, escalate to on-call infra and open emergency unpin with Acme ops approval.

I'll open a shared drive folder for artifacts and post links as they land.

-Markus
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>; Taylor Reed <taylor.reed@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 14:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private cluster - proposed maintenance window and version pin question

Couple of technical notes from the runtime side — thanks for the runbook, Taylor.

- Pin behavior: we'll implement a deployment annotation that prevents the auto-upgrade pipeline from touching the tenant's pods until the annotation is removed. That will be rolled out server-side and only impacts the pinned tenant.
- Rollback plan: v3.2.1 -> v3.1.9 rollback path has been tested internally; full KV-cache rebuild for a fleet of Acme's size (approx 120 nodes, avg-cached-prefix 120k tokens) is ~28-35 minutes in our lab. Plan for a 45-minute RTO window.
- Canary gating: recommend 20% traffic canary for the first 10 minutes with active tracing enabled; if stable, move to 60% for next 15 minutes and then full cutover. If any step fails gating thresholds, trigger rollback immediately.

Attachments: small config diff with pin annotation and a quick checklist I use for rollbacks (k8s-config-diff.txt).

[attachment: k8s-config-diff.txt (text/plain)]

I'll upload an artifact with sample commands to rehydrate ledgers and KV caches into the shared drive link Markus will create.

- Karthik
Senior Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime

From: Taylor Reed <taylor.reed@acmehealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, AcmeHealth Platform Ops <ops@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private cluster - proposed maintenance window and version pin question

Markus / team,

Thanks — that level of detail helps. We have an internal procurement freeze for the first two weeks of December, so the earlier window (2026-12-03) is preferable for us.

A few clarifications:
- We need immutable audit snapshots before the upgrade; can your team take a filesystem-level snapshot and export the logs to our secure bucket?
- For the pin: 3.2.1 is required because of a model-compatibility fix. Please ensure the pin prevents any sidecar or operator upgrades that could change runtime behavior.

If you can confirm the snapshot + the 45-minute RTO assumption is acceptable, we'll lock the Fri 2026-12-03 02:00-04:00 UTC window and share the on-call list.

Best,
Taylor

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Reed <taylor.reed@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private cluster - proposed maintenance window and version pin question

Taylor — confirmed. Summary and next steps:

Summary decisions:
- Window: Fri 2026-12-03 02:00-04:00 UTC (primary).
- Pin: Redwood will apply tenant annotation to hard-pin runtime to v3.2.1 and disable auto-upgrade operators for the tenant.
- RTO: We plan for a 45-minute rollback RTO; Karthik's estimate stands.
- Snapshots & logs: Neha will own immutable audit snapshot export and will push to your secure bucket prior to the window.
- Ownership: Redwood bridge leads: Markus (primary), Karthik (technical). Acme ops lead: Taylor Reed.

Pre-flight checklist (to be completed 48 hours before):
- Verify drive artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Cacme-runbook
- Confirm runbook acceptance (Taylor)
- Confirm blackout windows for backups (Monica)
- Smoke test plan signed-off and JIRA created: JIRA-OPS-5421

I'll open the incident bridge invite and post the dial-in + bridge roles by EOD tomorrow. If anything changes to your procurement freeze, ping Monica and we'll re-evaluate.

Thanks everyone — I will treat the bridge as the single source of truth during the window.

-Markus
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
